notes.title: COUCH COOP EVENT
notes.content:
Play our new and updated demo and try the magic of games without graphics at home!

Non-Virtual Reality Games is a collection of games you only play with the VR controllers, no headset needed! Instead of visuals, these games only use vibrations and sound to convey the game, while you play in the real world! 

[url=https://wonderl.ink/@nonvrgames]https://wonderl.ink/@nonvrgames[/url]

notes.title: Gamescom 2024
notes.content:
Non-VR Games is part of one of the biggest gaming event in the world, Gamescom 2024, taking place in Cologne Germany. 
Come by the A MAZE booth in Hall 10.2 to Hunt ghosts, create universes or to have a chat!

21. August to 25. August
https://gamescom.a-maze.net/

notes.title: A MAZE 2024
notes.content:
Non-Virtual Reality Games in nominated at this years A MAZE Festival in the category "[url=https://2024.amaze-berlin.de/nominees/]Human Human Machine[/url]". 

We will be exhibiting our project the whole festival in the ALT CTRL area. May 8th to May 11th in Berlin, Germany. Come by to give our game a try and lets have a chat!

Can't make it to Berlin this year? Don't worry, we just released our Demo here on Steam for you to try!

https://2024.amaze-berlin.de/
